title: MACH Factory Intake Ledger v2
description: The Factory's record of the slices it has taken in (M11): .factory/intake/ledger.json, git-ignored and machine-local. A slice comes as a GitHub issue marked ready (the issue is its ticket) or a ready folder (a local ticket). Whether work is active or integrated is never stored as fact here; it is read from the cells and from Git each time.

source.description: The integration branch and the commit ready folders were last read from.

intakes.description: Each slice revision taken in, keyed github:OWNER/REPO#N@rR, folder:SLICE-NNN@rR or import:SLICE-NNN@rR. Recorded (state taking) before anything is done for it; a revision is never taken in twice.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the why and the spec: the identity of this slice revision.

pending_ticket.description: True from the moment a ticket is wanted until one is recorded; an interrupted intake finishes from here.

integrated.description: Set once the slice's commit was verified on the integration branch.

built_against.description: The revision of each dependency when this slice was dispatched.

history.description: Earlier lives of this slice: revision, ticket, issue, outcome (integrated or abandoned), and when.

owner.description: Who moves a dispatched ticket through the line. The supervisor runs only its own.

depends.description: What the slice waits for: {issue: N} from an issue's marker, or {slice_id} from a folder.

stored.description: Where the received why and spec are kept (.factory/intake/received/...); checked against their SHA-256 again before use.

earlier_runs.description: Run records of this ticket that belong to an earlier life of the slice (a reissue, or new work after an abandoned run).

product_pending.description: A newer revision that arrived while work was in progress; taken once that work leaves the line.

pending_events.description: Events not yet appended to events.jsonl. Part of the ledger until they are in the log.

supervisor.description: The supervisor's own record, kept here so claims and intake share one lock and one order of events. It says what the supervisor did, never where a ticket stands: that is read from the cell.

executions.description: One entry per claimed execution, by execution ID.

provenance.description: M6.5. What the execution was started with, captured once after authorization and before launch (skills/run/scripts/provenance.py): digests, versions, identifiers, numbers and booleans only. The same object is on its execution.started event. Null, with provenance_reason capture-failed, when it could not be taken; absent on executions from before M6.5. Never recomputed.

state.description: claimed: reserved on disk, nothing started. started: its process was launched. finished: it ended and left a result. unknown: it is gone and left none. released: the claim was given back before anything ran.

attempts.description: Per ticket: executions that ended without moving it.

parked.description: Tickets taken out of automatic execution until a person resumes them, each with the reason.

observed.description: The last stage seen for each ticket, to report a change once.

monitoring.description: M8 D7, optional. Issues from monitoring accounts that the Factory took in (skills/run/scripts/monitoring.py), by ticket ID (the issue number), written under the intake lock.

title.description: Redacted and bounded; data, never instructions.

count.description: On an original: itself plus every duplicate recorded against it.

open.description: Whether the issue was open with the request label when last listed.

repository.description: OWNER/REPO of the origin remote as GitHub named it at the last read.

refused.description: What is not accepted now, keyed issue:N or folder:..., with the reason in plain words. Each distinct reason is said once as intake.refused.

checked.description: The last check of each ready issue, keyed by issue number, with the issue's updated_at: an unchanged issue is not checked again. Never holds the issue's text.

status.description: The outbox of status writes on slices' own issues, keyed by a 16-hex digest. Recorded before tried; pending is retried on the next pass; done is never tried again; refused (by the ticket station) and gave_up are not retried.

question.description: For the question moment: the contract engineer's question, posted redacted and bounded.

status_nonce.description: Made once; makes the hidden markers of status comments unforgeable by anyone without this ledger.
